notes: PROPOSED 2026-08-31 from the FLOW-12 brief. The owner's home: today's activity, pending requests, upcoming bookings, and quick actions. The brief warns against turning this into a generic analytics dashboard, so the numbers are few and each one links to the thing it counts. "quiet" is the honest state for a business with nothing happening today. Corrected 2026-09-01: collectionsTouched said "businesses", a collection that does not exist in the canonical schema and had no firestore.rules block. Business profiles are UserDoc records with profileType==="BUSINESS" (admin/types/firestore.ts:181-209) — this screen reads /users like every other profile screen, not a separate collection. See docs/09-Roadmap/screen-contract-chain.md.
